constraints.text: His ship has been at sea... anchored some three miles offshore; Fonseca races to the pier but cannot reach his ship; twelve-foot waves and a fierce swell force his small boat back to shore.
constraints.reading: Recurring 'three miles' figure and a shore-to-water dynamic; if read as spatial imagery, the target sits near the edge of water with the hide a measured short distance (about three miles) from an access point/road, mirroring the hunt's ~3-mile-from-road rule. The 'cannot reach it from the pier' frames a spot just beyond easy reach but still close.

constraints.text: Through his telescope, Fonseca watches 'his Lady of the Light drifting away.'
constraints.reading: A long-distance line of sight from a fixed vantage looking out over open water; suggests a hiding spot with a sweeping outward view, possibly toward or across water, where one stands and looks far off.

constraints.text: Nuestra Senora de la Luz ('Our Lady of the Light'); the 'Lady of the Light' name extends the book's recurring light/illumination motif.
constraints.reading: Light/illumination imagery; a spot that is sunlit, catches the light, faces a sunrise/sunset direction, or is associated with a high open exposure rather than deep shade. Marian title, explicitly NOT a literal lighthouse.

constraints.text: a round knob on its face created when additional gold was added to increase its mass (gold bar); over 22 troy ounces gold disk, the disk shape.
constraints.reading: Described objects emphasize a flat bar with a raised rounded knob, and a round disk. If an object's shape echoes a landform, this suggests a flat surface (ledge/slab) bearing a distinct rounded bump/boulder, or a circular rounded stone feature.

constraints.text: Wreckage was strewn over fifty miles... a site some fifty miles from the bay of Montevideo.
constraints.reading: Scattered debris over a large span; spatially weak, but reinforces dispersal along a shoreline/edge rather than a single deep point. Likely not a hide constraint, noted for completeness.

constraints.text: hidden in barrels deep in the ship's powder hold... the hidden powder-hold treasure was never recovered because it was never supposed to exist.
constraints.reading: Imagery of treasure concealed in a deep, enclosed, hidden hold/cavity rather than in plain view; charitably suggests the hide is tucked into a recess, crevice, or enclosed pocket (a 'hold'-like nook) rather than fully exposed.

constraints.text: The author states 'I placed all our boxes in safe locations' and directs readers to best-practices; not dangerous, accessible.
constraints.reading: Negative spatial constraint on the spot itself: the hide is NOT on a cliff face, in water, or anywhere requiring dangerous scrambling; it is a safe, reachable stance. Filter, not a pinpoint.
